messages:
sara_support: Heads up — a paying customer (acme-payments) is hitting a large spike of 503s starting ~11:03 UTC. They report upstream inference worker crashes (GPU killed). Sending customer logs now.
mike_infra: I see the alert. Notable: node gpu-pool-14 showing repeated container restarts, OOM on /usr/local/bin/infer-runner. kube events show CrashLoopBackOff.
dinesh_ml: Any change recently deployed to the model or quantization profile for that route? acme uses r-instruct-1b-quantized-v2.
sara_support: They said they flipped to quantized-v2 last night. Before that it was fine.
alex_sre: Can you paste the tail of the runner logs from the timestamp around the crash? Also need dmesg / kernel logs from the node.
opsbot: @alex_sre requested logs. Pulling last 500 lines from the pod now.
sara_support: Logs (redacted):
```
[11:03:27] infer-runner ERROR: segfault in attn_kernel.cu: invalid device pointer
[11:03:27] infer-runner INFO: dumping core to /var/crash/runner.core
[11:03:27] nvidia: GPU 0 terminated unexpectedly (SIGABRT)
[11:03:28] kubelet: Container killed: exit code 139
```
mike_infra: dmesg excerpt from node:
```
[Thu Mar 13 11:03:27] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[Thu Mar 13 11:03:28] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 32456 (infer-runner) score 154
```
dinesh_ml: That pattern (Xid 79 + segfault in attention kernel) matches a known failure when allocating KV cache for very long context + aggressive batching on quantized kernels.
jen_product: Customer says their average context length jumped from ~2k to ~12k after switching to our new convo-preserve prompt template. They hit a batch spike of 24 concurrent requests.
alex_sre: Repro hypothesis: long context causes overcommit of GPU memory in quantized path -> kernel gets an invalid ptr -> segfault -> GPU reset -> container restart.
sara_support: Customer provided a minimal repro: send 6 concurrent requests with context len 12k each to /v1/generate with model=r-instruct-1b-quantized-v2
mike_infra: I'm going to cordon gpu-pool-14 and move active traffic using routing policy. Will initiate immediate fallback to r-instruct-1b-fp16 for that customer.
opsbot: Routing change applied: acme-payments -> r-instruct-1b-fp16 (fallback) for 30m. No further 503s from them in the last 5m.
dinesh_ml: For reproducing locally: run the test harness with env VARS:
```
export BATCH_SIZE=6
export CONTEXT_LEN=12000
python tests/runtime_repro.py --model r-instruct-1b-quantized-v2
```
Also capture `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` while running.
alex_sre: Temporary mitigations: 1) limit max_batch_size to 4 on quantized variants; 2) add a preflight check in router to reject single requests that would allocate >X tokens; 3) pin to fp16 for accounts with recent context expansions.
jen_product: We need an incident note for the customer + include recommended mitigation in docs. Also product decision: should we mark quantized-v2 as unsafe above 8k context until patched.
mike_infra: Action items: - roll back quantized-v2 rollout (done for acme route) - patch autoscaler to reduce concurrency to avoid multi-batch allocations - collect core dumps and send to ML team.
opsbot: Collected core dump at s3://redwood-incident-archives/1745001234/runner-core-acme-11-03-27.core
sara_support: Customer notified about fallback and ETA for a fix (we suggested fp16 fallback and rate-limit adjustments). They accepted temporary mitigation.
dinesh_ml: Next steps for ML: reproduce with nvprof, bisect commit in quantized kernel, instrument KV allocation guards. If repro, push hotfix to avoid unbounded allocation and check for invalid pointer returns.
alex_sre: Postmortem checklist: record root cause as GPU memory over-allocation in quantized attention kernel leading to invalid pointer and GPU reset. Add monitoring for Xid 79 spikes and per-route high-context alerts.
jen_product: I'll open a product ticket to add a UX guardrail and update the model catalog with explicit context limits for quantized variants.
sara_support: Closing loop: customer has resumed traffic on fp16, requests watch window. I'll follow up in 24h then close.
mike_infra: I'll schedule a canary rollback of quantized-v2 for broad routes and prepare a patch for a config knob --max-alloc-bytes.
opsbot: Incident annotation: severity P2, impacted single customer with potential broader risk. Logged actions and artifacts to incident page.
alex_sre: Thanks team — keep threads tight. If ML needs hardware access I can provision a debug GPU node.

<end>
